sources_used.source: BestProsInTown East Brunswick category pages (plumbers, HVAC, electricians, roofing, contractors, landscapers, flooring, tree service, pest control)
Yahoo Local East Brunswick category listings (general contractors, plumbing, roofing, auto repairs, towing, tires, movers, gutter cleaning, appliance repair)
Google Maps area search around East Brunswick
Birdeye business profiles and category directories

categories_thin: Tire shops: every East Brunswick tire listing found (Mavis, Mr. Tire, Firestone, Pep Boys, Midas, Monike/Monro, Meineke) is a national chain and excluded - no independent tire dealer confirmed.

Moving and storage: no independently owned East Brunswick moving company with a published town address was confirmed; results were national van lines, brokers (Movers.com, Metro Auto Rescue) or franchises (Two Men and a Truck).

Security and alarm installers: only one East Brunswick-based firm (Alarm Distributors) plus national/regional brands (Slomin's, BGS, Certified Protection) that are based elsewhere - thin because BBB, Yellow Pages and Angi security category pages were all blocked.
Septic, well and water treatment: only Budget Drain & Septic confirmed; most well/septic work here is county- or lab-related rather than a local contractor list.
Roofing and general contracting: many entries have no street address and no phone because the source directory hides contact details; these will need lookup by the triage team.

Restoration and mold: the firms that came up (SERVPRO franchise, RDC, Calvary, Quality 1st, Basement Waterproofing by Al) are based outside East Brunswick, so coverage of in-town restoration shops is thin.
caveats: Zone is the town of East Brunswick itself. Contractors based in Milltown, Spotswood, Old Bridge, North Brunswick, South River or Sayreville that merely advertise 'serving East Brunswick' were generally left out unless the listing gave an East Brunswick address.

Several entries come from a single listing page that shows only name, address and phone (Yahoo Local page 1, SuperPages summaries, LocalSolution summaries). Those are marked 'one directory only' and need confirmation.

Yellow Pages, BBB category pages, Angi category pages, Manta, BuildZoom, Cylex and LocalSolution all returned HTTP 403 or Cloudflare blocks when opened directly, so those categories could only be mined from search-engine snippets, not walked page by page.

Excluded as chains or franchises even though they serve East Brunswick: TemperaturePro Central NJ (11 Harts Ln), SERVPRO of East Brunswick, AAMCO Transmissions (545 Rt 18), Firestone, Mavis, Monro, Pep Boys, Midas, Meineke, Mr. Tire, Safelite, Two Men and a Truck, 1-800-GOT-JUNK, Buildingstars, Vanguard Cleaning Systems, Conserva Irrigation, Ace Handyman Services, Window Genie, Fish Window Cleaning, Slomin's.
East Brunswick Supply (413 Rt 18) is a plumbing supply wholesaler/retailer rather than a trade contractor, so it was left out of group C.
Contractors' addresses on residential streets may be home offices; that is normal for small licensed trades in New Jersey and is not by itself disqualifying.
data_gaps: Overpass/OpenStreetMap API was unreachable (connection aborted on two mirrors), so the OSM sweep of craft= and shop=car_repair tags could not be performed.
Google Maps only rendered a 5-result 'limited view' per query in this browser session, so Maps could not be paged for full coverage of any category.
No East Brunswick township business directory or licensed-contractor list was located; the municipal site was not usable as a business source.
BestProsInTown hides phone numbers behind interactive listing pages, so many otherwise well-reviewed contractors are recorded with phone 'Unknown'.
Yahoo Local pages beyond page 1 render advertisement blocks without addresses or phone numbers, so deep paging produced few usable records.
No chamber of commerce or business-improvement association member directory specific to East Brunswick was found.
